scope: Conventional mathematical proofs with explicit hypotheses, independent reviews and bounded authenticated source comparisons. Exact examples supplement universal written proofs. No upstream Lean build, complete dependency audit or proof of RH/GRH is claimed.

packages.kind: proved sharp matrix inequality and conditional arithmetic application
packages.proof_review: Projection test plus reverse triangle inequality and coordinatewise monotonicity of B-(2m-A)_+^2; sharp scalar configurations, countable passage, actual source and target restrictions.
packages.retained_requirements: Uniform arithmetic smallness and the original target loss.

packages.proof_review: All commutation powers and original source factors retained, including varying intermediate ranks. The ambient space is over an arbitrary extension E/K; no unproved K-linearity of individual source operators is assumed.
packages.retained_requirements: Original local kernels and value lattices, stabilizer units, twisted ties and other period denominators.

packages.proof_review: Blow up only the base ideal, choose one finite etale fibre of a generic projection, and use a curve section to bound vanishing. Strict integer threshold, base loci, D=1 and exact surplus denominator checked.
packages.retained_requirements: Actual projective section realization, nef and birational identifications and arithmetic section remainder.

packages.kind: proved graded algebra and representation comparison
packages.proof_review: Automatic locality/continuity, finite coefficient field, homogeneous-tail completion, permitted grading rescaling, faithful matrix-entry tangent map and marked coboundary calculation independently checked.
packages.retained_requirements: Actual weighted presentation, finite degree-zero quotient and arithmetic models; global rigidity and uniform integral bounds. The local condition is supplied by the next package from its exact model hypotheses.

packages.kind: proved probability, invariant-measure and arithmetic spanning implications
packages.proof_review: Tonelli supplies integrability and removes the unknown normalization; Haar invariance plus one integrable count gives coarea homogeneity on nonzero isotropic cones. Short integral pairings, rational spanning by integral cyclotomic traces and the exact 23/24 and allowance-3 bounds checked.
packages.retained_requirements: Original Haar quotient, lattice and covolume, finite volume and one integrable count, actual component weights and signed boundary limit. The abstract probability-measure contract alone is insufficient to identify a Haar quotient.

packages.kind: proved local comparison using explicitly cited classical theorems
packages.proof_review: Three ordered matrix substitutions give the ordinary flag and spectral-projector nonresonance factors. Local duality gives fixed-type crystalline field points; saturation and the Jacobson generic fibre place Kisin’s ideal in the radical. All finite-algebra points, including dual numbers, follow from his actual theorem. Exact adjoint=End identity and coefficient-linear period splitting checked; no residual irreducibility hypothesis introduced.
packages.retained_requirements: Actual global-to-local ordinary quotient and finite inertia equations, global non-diagonal rigidity and uniform integral Selmer bounds. The e>=2 simplification changes only this local deduction, not the selected source component.

packages.kind: proved limitation and bounded source investigation
packages.proof_review: Unitary transvections give infinitely many distinct finite-supported rational returns at every depth in the isotropic case. Qualitative weighted integrability is distinguished from a quantitative relative tail.
packages.retained_requirements: No archimedean nonvanishing for each supported term is asserted; actual retained leading mass and target-loss comparison remain.

packages.kind: authenticated source estimate, proved cutoff and moment comparison
packages.proof_review: The source normalized kernel estimate is retained as an inspected interface. The cutoff epsilon=1/(8n^2) satisfies every displayed condition at h>=16n^19. Covariance rules out a full-group Whittaker decay transfer. A strict integer-count probability example proves the exact inverse-moment threshold, without asserting arithmetic divergence.
packages.retained_requirements: Full proof of the imported kernel estimate was not reconstructed or built. Original near-return and cusp bounds, dimension/minimum identifications, actual period-Gram transfer or quotient Bessel estimate, retained source inclusion and target loss remain.
